title: ColoredArmorHUD
description: Material-aware armor HUD with trims, glow, and durability alerts.
body: Colored Armor HUD is a client-side mod that makes the armor HUD reflect your equipped armor materials, trims, and enchantments. It supports mixed armor sets, customizable enchantment glow, an optional equipped-armor display, and low-durability warnings. Available for Fabric and NeoForge.
